statement: For four translates of a short smooth test at spacings log 2, the genuine Weil off-diagonal form magnitude on the constant coefficient vector exceeds the previously guaranteed single-window coercivity floor. Thus a gluing proof replacing each diagonal by that fixed floor and estimating cross terms cannot work.
hypotheses: Same unconditional explicit formula and normalization as RH-B002; support length L=1/1024; four translates at j log 2.
definitions: Prime-power shift, archimedean separated kernel, pole kernel, four-dimensional compressed form matrix.
proof_or_gap: Only n=2^j contributes at each separation j log2, j=1,2,3. Bound smooth mixed term by 8L||f||², prime weights below by 2/5,1/3,2/9. Constant-vector cross magnitude exceeds 317/768. True diagonal may be larger; actual form negativity is not implied.
implication_to_claim: Identifies a precise failure of fixed-floor gluing and the need for a frequency-dependent diagonal estimate; not global Weil positivity.
unproved_dependencies: Sharp relative form control using actual diagonal symbol and prime couplings on arbitrary supports, global positivity or independent spectral realization.
adversarial_findings: The lower bound on off-diagonal magnitude is not a negative direction for the actual Weil form; the replacement diagonal is a lower bound only.
